text.p: Oppenheimer & Co analyst Paul Hayes said he had cut Lomak Petroleum Inc to market perform from outperform after the company disappointed with second quarter earnings per share of $0.09 against his forecast of $0.12 and against $0.15 in the year-ago second quarter.
-- "The company spent most of the second quarter trying to arrest production from American Cometra instead of expanding reserves," Hayes said in a telephone interview.
-- Lomak said in January that it was buying oil and gas properties from American Cometra Inc and reported second quarter earnings on August 6.
-- "We still think this is a good company," said Hayes. ((-- David Chance New York Newsroom 212 859 1902))
